thresholds.derivation: Spec pair (14_GATES_CONVERG B) retained for reference-engine parity; under it PCA reads STRONG for 100% of matched and 95% of unmatched families (competency attainment saturates at ~98/93), MIL reads STRONG for 12%/9% (no family signal), 360 for 35%/2%. per_instrument recut with tools/careerfit/recut_thresholds.py; SIMULATED values are calibrated to the regression generator and must be re-cut on a real cohort (FM-CF-014).

decisions.decision: One mapping, a pure function of the phrase (pca.qualifier_mapping). Selected by tools/careerfit/select_qualifier_mapping.py: the only candidate injective on the sheet's 8 phrases, so no two archetypes encode identically; mean 12-way recovery 40.8% vs 41.1% best (noise), best at coherence 1.0 (72.4%), zero dead archetypes.
decisions.consequence: Under the previous draft (all Neutral phrases w2) DIRECTOR and COMERCIAL_TECNICO, and ASESOR and SERVICIO_CLIENTE, were identical rules; the second of each pair could never be a winning route. Bare Activo/Pasivo now weigh 2 and 'fuerte' 3, so route_factor_weight expresses the sheet's intensity qualifier -- the engine has no other knob for it.
decisions.source: 02_PCA_LOGICA rows 15-26; rule 'La distancia a 50 determina intensidad'

decisions.decision: Literal C/I/CO as written. 'X/Y' -> X at family level, Y recorded as subfamily_candidate (the note in the same row says Y applies in named branches). 'VAR' -> the MEDIAN role across the family's subfamilies when a subfamily sheet exists (only Ingeniería, sheet 12; absent = NOT_USED, ties round up), else IMPORTANT. 'I_MIN' -> the same, floored at IMPORTANT. 'INHERIT' -> family is not scorable (15).
decisions.consequence: Ingeniería resolves DC=C RZ=C VN=C MT=I OR=CO from its 12 subfamilies (DC critical in 7/12, VN 8/12, RZ 12/12, MT important 12/12, OR critical 3 / important 2 / complementary 1 / absent 6). Every family now has a non-null MIL fit; before, 12 of 15 carried an unresolved marker and Ingeniería scored 0.0 on every profile.

decisions.decision: Two POLE routes per family (one for Formación Técnica) read off sheet 09 Personality_Rule prose; carried from the analysis session unchanged. Personality never gates (sheet 05).

decisions.decision: Per-instrument thresholds (thresholds.convergence.per_instrument) replace the spec's single 70/55 pair, which never binds for PCA and cannot bind for MIL; MIL uses the official MIL bands. The single pair is kept for reference-engine parity. See thresholds.derivation.
decisions.consequence: Convergence counts become meaningful: under the recut PCA is STRONG for 85% matched / 29% unmatched, Personality 93%/36%, 360 90%/19%, MIL 85%/81% (capacity, not family). Values marked SIMULATED are calibrated to the generator, not to students.

CALL_CENTER and VENDEDOR_TECNICO are in the archetype catalogue but referenced by no family's PCA_Routes; kept for occupation-level inheritance, unused by V1 family scoring.

source_discrepancies.model_config: ONE global table applied to all five subtests, spanning 1-99: INSUFFICIENT 1-17, LOW 18-37, ADEQUATE 38-56, EXCEEDS 57-81, EXCEPTIONAL 82-99. formmaps_engine_reference.mil_band() hardcodes the same numbers and require_range()s the percentile to 1..99.
source_discrepancies.official_evaluator: FIVE per-subtest tables spanning 0-100 (LIA Evaluator.xlsx): DC 0-11/12-31/32-62/63-82/83-100 | RZ 0-9/10-30/31-61/62-83/84-100 | VN 0-8/9-25/26-51/52-75/76-100 | MT 0-7/8-28/29-58/59-80/81-100 | OR 0-8/9-16/17-42/43-70/71-100. A separate global table exists for the MEAN of the five percentiles (0-9/10-20/21-57/58-74/75-100), and it does not match the model_config table either.
source_discrepancies.evidence_that_the_evaluator_governs: A real TIMS-issued report (student A, 2024-10-21; DC96 RZ73 VN55 MT57 OR78) matches the per-subtest tables on 5 of 5 subtests and the model_config table on 2 of 5. The three it 'fails' under model_config -- VN 55 Excede, MT 57 Adecuado, OR 78 Excepcional -- are all correct under the per-subtest tables.
source_discrepancies.measured_impact: Band LABEL differs on 149 of 495 subtest-percentile cells (30.1%); visual rotation differs across 54.5% of its range. The GATE (which inlines the same 17/37 boundaries rather than calling mil_band) differs on 96 of 505 cells (19.0%), and model_config is UNIFORMLY HARSHER -- every disagreement blocks or conditions a family the student qualifies for under the official bands.
source_discrepancies.explains: OPEN_QUESTIONS' 'unequal MIL ceilings' entry and the 0->1 / 100->99 clamp in MilAdapter: the model_config table cannot express P0 or P100, which the instrument actually produces (a perfect raw score reaches P100 on DC, VN and OR).

Unequal MIL ceilings: a perfect raw score reaches P100 on DC/VN/OR but P99 on RZ and P95 on MT. Now believed to be a symptom of the mil_bands conflict below, not a separate issue.

WHICH MIL BANDS GOVERN? Two TIMS artefacts disagree (see source_discrepancies, scope=instrument): formmaps_model_config_v1.json gives ONE table for all five subtests spanning 1-99, while the official LIA Evaluator.xlsx gives FIVE per-subtest tables spanning 0-100. A real TIMS-issued report matches the per-subtest tables 5/5 and the model_config table 2/5, so the evaluator appears to govern -- but the model_config table is what the normative reference engine hardcodes, so switching is a spec change, not a bug fix. It moves 19.0% of the gate surface, always in the student's favour.
